verification.scope: Read-only causal diagnostic in selected fixed development trajectories; enumerate every legal discard at each selected game's last learner discard, then resume unchanged policies on the same actual deal. This hindsight root selection is not a deployable policy, public-belief teacher, strength evaluation or training dataset.

selection.scope: Read-only diagnosis: first numeric development deal in each rule/seat cell with a strict loss, rated capacity below opponent powered count, and at least50 final money, plus first strict win. This is selected outcome sampling, not new strength evidence or causal proof.

interpretation: Five of eight deliberately selected loss trajectories can be changed to wins by a single legal last-discard intervention. Prefixes and original full action traces match exactly. Root selection uses hindsight and outcomes use the actual fixed deal; this is conditional causal diagnosis, not a prevalence estimate, public-belief teacher, deployable policy or strength evaluation. Rated capacity alone is not fuel availability. Evaluate public endgame-aware discard decisions on fresh games before using them as guidance or changing priors.

correction.reason: Initial draft incorrectly enumerated all five held plants. The authoritative engine forbids discarding the newly bought plant. The first branch stopped at exact legal-set validation; no branch results were analyzed. This revision preserves all16 selected roots and enumerates the four exact engine-legal choices per root. Failed evidence retained under runs/two-player-discard-counterfactual-v1.

base_runtime.purpose: Controlled frozen-weight test of full legal bids in sealed auctions. No training or final qualification.
